input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: The grant meets the preferred position. Section 13.1 extends the subscription licence to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf (worldwide, no notice condition needed, so better than the fallback). Section 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up or embedded Vendor Technology, with contractor support rights. Section 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24 assignment right (which allows Customer assignment to a successor in an M&A transaction without consent) and confines Vendor revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity. Nothing is revocable at Vendor's discretion, and the use restrictions in 13.4 are ordinary and carve out legally protected activities. No redline required.
